fullContentHtml:
Short Information : All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, has released the Notification for the various Common Recruitment Examination (CRE) Group-B and Group-C Posts. This recruitment is released for 1484 posts. Applications for the AIIMS CRE Group B, C Recruitment 2026 has started from 13 June 2026, and candidates can apply till 03 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for AIIMS CRE Group B, C Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)

AIIMS CRE Group B & C Recruitment 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 13 June 2026
  • Last Date : 03 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 July 2026
  • NOC Submit Form : 08 July 2026
  • Form Status Check Date : 11 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 25-27 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result Declared Date : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 3000/-
  • SC, ST, EWS : Rs. 2400/-
  • For PwD : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

AIIMS CRE Group B & C Various Post Notification 2026 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On AIIMS Rules
  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 21-50 Years (Post Wise)
  • Age Relaxation as per AIIMS CRE Group B & C Various Post Recruitment Rules.

Post Name Qualifications
AIIMS CRE 5th Group B, C
  • Candidates must have passed 10th / 12th, Graduation, or Post Graduation in any discipline from a recognized university or possess an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government.
